description:
Hosoo likes taking pictures of guys who cry during the deed, so he's delighted when he stumbles home drunk and finds his roommate and childhood friend, Wooyeong, pleasuring himself in tears. This leads to the two having a passionate night together, but somehow, their hookup isn't the biggest issue the morning after. An angry Wooyeong tells Hosoo he found the picture he took with his boyfriend and demands to know why he hid the fact that he was dating someone. When their argument results in Wooyeong storming out of their apartment, Hosoo fears he might've lost his closest friend for good...

(Source: Tappytoon)
